title: Pirini Ponders: June 2019
summary: A healthy eating project with Bethesda, a water need at Mamosa village, and a ramp and toilet for the hospital school.
body:
Greetings again from the Solomon Islands. We are thankful for a couple of weeks' leave in New Zealand and Fiji, including the engagement of our daughter Charlotte to Ben Starr and time with our granddaughter Lily. We are grateful that the base ran smoothly in our absence, thanks to our staff's hard work.

We are working with Bethesda Disability Centre on a healthy eating and nutrition pilot. Once the materials, model gardens and kitchens are ready, we will train SWIM and Bethesda staff and families, and later the wider community, in what a healthy plate looks like.

We visited Mamosa village, about 90 minutes' drive from the base. We found a need for a water tank, classroom repairs and community toilets. The village collects all its water from a spring into a container. The plan is to dam the spring and pipe water to a tank so there is a constant supply. If you have a team looking for a mission trip, let us know.

Our staff are building a ramp and an inside toilet at the hospital school, a long-overdue need. Students who are patients will be able to reach the classroom from the hospital and have a bathroom to use.

Otherwise it has been general repairs and maintenance, and helping our local church with building work and an upcoming convention.

Prayer: thanks for a refreshing holiday; for our families at home; and for the SIW board as it plans and recruits staff for the base after a recent review.

All our love and God's blessings, Ron and Tanya
